info.title: Voicegram Public API
info.description:
The Voicegram public API lets you integrate Voicegram with Zapier, Make,
n8n, or any custom system. All requests authenticate via a Personal Access
Token (PAT) sent in the `Authorization: Bearer vg_pat_<...>` header.

## Authentication

Create a PAT in the Voicegram dashboard at `/dashboard/integrations/api-tokens`.
Tokens are bound to a single account and inherit that account's permissions.
The token format is `vg_pat_<64-hex>`; only the prefix is stored in plaintext
server-side, so the token is unrecoverable from the dashboard after creation.

## Plan gating

All endpoints except `GET /api/v1/me` require a paid plan (Starter or above).
PATs for free-plan accounts authenticate successfully against `/me` so
integrations can display a meaningful upgrade prompt, but every other
endpoint returns `403 plan_required`.

## Rate limiting

Each endpoint is rate limited per account. On `429 rate_limited`,
back off and retry.

## Webhook delivery semantics

Webhook URLs registered via `POST /api/v1/webhook-subscriptions` must be
terminal receivers: any `3xx` response is treated as a delivery failure
recorded as `redirect_blocked: <status>`. Configure your endpoint to
respond directly with `2xx`, `4xx`, or `5xx`. See
https://voicegram.io/docs/integrations/webhooks for details.

Outbound deliveries POST a JSON body signed with an HMAC in the
`X-Voicegram-Signature` header (`t=<unix-seconds>,v1=<hex-hmac>`),
and each attempt carries a unique `X-Voicegram-Delivery-Id` header
(UUID, fresh per attempt) for support correlation. Failed deliveries
are retried with backoff over several hours before auto-disable.

get.description:
Verifies the PAT and returns the authenticated account's basic info.
Use it to verify a token and confirm which account it belongs to, for
example on an integration's connection screen.

Unlike every other endpoint, `/me` does NOT plan-gate. Free-plan PATs
authenticate successfully here so an integration can detect a free-plan
account and prompt the user to upgrade.

Returns the domains and campaigns owned by the authenticated account.
Use it to populate a channel picker so users can scope an integration to a single channel.

Sort order: domains first (alphabetical by domain), then campaigns
(alphabetical by name).

Returns the N most-recent completed Voicegrams for the PAT's account,
in the canonical `voicegram.completed` payload shape.

Accounts with no completed Voicegrams receive a single sample row (clearly marked).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
How many Voicegrams to return. Defaults to 3. Values outside the
allowed range are clamped to the nearest valid value; non-integer or
unparseable input falls back to the default.

post.description:
Creates a webhook subscription that fires the `voicegram.completed`
event to the supplied URL on every matching completed Voicegram for
the account.

## Terminal receiver requirement

The URL MUST be a terminal receiver. Your endpoint must respond
directly with `2xx/4xx/5xx`; a `3xx` response is treated as a delivery
failure (recorded as `redirect_blocked`). This applies to real-event
delivery, retry delivery, and the dashboard's test-event endpoint.

## Secret handling

The response includes the plaintext signing `secret` ONCE. After this
response the plaintext is unrecoverable from the API; `secret_prefix`
is the only identifier surfaced afterwards. Save the plaintext in a
secure secret store on your end. If you lose it, delete the subscription
and create a new one to rotate.

## URL validation

- MUST use HTTPS (`http://` returns `400 invalid_url`).
- MUST be a valid URI under 2048 characters.
- MUST NOT contain user/password credentials (`https://user:pass@host`).
- The URL must not point to a private or internal host.

## Subscription cap

Active subscriptions per account are capped at 25. The 26th
subscription returns `409 limit_reached`. Deleted subscriptions
don't count toward the cap.

## channel_id resolution

If `channel_id` is provided, it must be a domain or campaign on your
account. Returns `400 invalid_channel_id` if no match exists.

dashboard.summary: Dashboard-source subscription scoped to a domain

201.description:
Subscription created. The response includes the plaintext signing
`secret` exactly once.

400.description:
Body failed validation. The `error` field disambiguates:
- `validation_error`: generic schema failure (see `issues`)
- `invalid_url`: URL is not HTTPS, contains credentials, or
  targets a private/internal host (the `reason` field carries a
  stable diagnostic enum string)
- `invalid_channel_id`: `channel_id` does not match any domain
  or campaign on the PAT's account

value.message: URL must be HTTPS and not target a private/internal host.
channel_id does not match any domain or campaign on your account.

409.description:
Conflict. Either the active-subscription cap of 25 has been
reached (`limit_reached`), or a Zapier subscription with this
`zapier_subscription_id` already exists (`conflict`).

value.message: Active subscription limit of 25 reached. Delete or disable an existing subscription before creating a new one.
A subscription with this zapier_subscription_id already exists.

get.description:
Lists webhook subscriptions for the PAT's account. Includes both
active (`is_active=true`) and soft-deleted (`is_active=false`) rows
unless filtered.

Sort order is `created_at DESC` (newest first).

`pagination.total` counts rows matching the request's filters
(`account_id` + `source` + `is_active`), ignoring `limit`/`offset`.
Use it to determine whether further pages exist.

Never returns the plaintext `secret`. The plaintext was returned
once in the POST 201 response and is unrecoverable from the API
afterwards.

parameters.name: is_active
parameters.description: Filter to active or soft-deleted rows.

200.description: Subscription list with filter-aware pagination total

issues.message: Number must be less than or equal to 100

get.description:
Returns a single webhook subscription for the PAT's account.
Returns `404` whether the subscription does not exist or belongs
to a different account. Never returns the plaintext `secret`.

delete.description: Delete a webhook subscription. Stops all future deliveries.

PersonalAccessToken.description:
Personal Access Token issued from the Voicegram dashboard. Format:
`vg_pat_` followed by 64 hex characters. Voicegram never stores the
plaintext after creation; tokens are therefore unrecoverable. If you
lose a token, revoke it and create a new one.

account_name.description: Display name of the account (or "Unnamed Account" if unset).

plan_name.description: Plan slug. Free-plan accounts can call `/me` but no other endpoint.

plan_tier_index.description:
Position of `plan_name` in the canonical tier ordering
`[free, starter, pro, business, enterprise]`. Useful for "is
plan at least X?" checks without coupling to the slug list.

plan_retention_days.description:
How many days completed Voicegrams are retained for this account
before the audio is deleted. `null` means unlimited retention
(Business / Enterprise). This is the account's own retention
window, useful for surfacing "your recordings are kept for N days"
in an integration.

name.description:
For `type=domain` this is the hostname (e.g. `acme.com`). For
`type=campaign` this is the campaign display name.

slug.description:
URL-safe slug. Only present for `type=campaign`; absent on
domain rows.

VoicegramCompleted.description:
Canonical `voicegram.completed` payload shape. This is the exact
shape POSTed to webhook URLs and also the shape returned by
`GET /api/v1/voicegrams/recent`.

event_id.description:
Stable event identifier of the form `evt_<uuid>`. The SAME value
is sent across retries of the same event. Customers requiring
exactly-once delivery should deduplicate on this field.

delivered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this delivery attempt fired.

verification_method.description:
The channel the sender used to give their contact
information (`email`, `sms` or `whatsapp`). Whether it was
confirmed is in `contact_verified`. The name predates
optional verification and is kept so existing integrations
keep working.

contact_verified.description:
`true` when the sender proved they own this email address
or phone number by entering a one-time code before
recording. `false` when the verification code was turned
off for the widget or campaign: the email or phone is
exactly what the sender typed and was never confirmed, so
it may be mistyped or belong to someone else.

email.description:
Populated when `verification_method=email`, null
otherwise. Exactly one of `email`, `phone`, and
`whatsapp` is populated.

phone.description:
E.164 number, populated when `verification_method=sms`,
null otherwise. Exactly one of `email`, `phone`, and
`whatsapp` is populated.

whatsapp.description:
E.164 number, populated when
`verification_method=whatsapp`, null otherwise. Exactly
one of `email`, `phone`, and `whatsapp` is populated.

page_url.description:
Page URL where the Voicegram was recorded. Null for
campaign-sourced Voicegrams.

summary.description:
Structured AI summary object. Groups urgency, sentiment, intent,
callback_required, action items, and extracted entities.

urgency.description: AI-classified urgency. Null when not classified.

callback_required.description: True when the caller explicitly requested a callback.

action_items.description:
AI-extracted action items, normalized to objects with
`task`, `priority`, and `deadline`.

mentioned.description: AI-extracted entities mentioned in the call.

names.description: People or companies mentioned by name.

url.description:
Signed listen URL backed by a per-recipient listener
token. Validity is plan-scaled: 30 days (Free), 90
days (Starter), 365 days (Pro / Business /
Enterprise). After expiry or revocation, the URL
returns `403`. If the underlying audio file has been
deleted (plan retention reached), the URL returns
`410`. For permanent access, use the auth-gated
`dashboard_url` or re-fetch the Voicegram via this
API to receive a fresh URL.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which `url` stops working.

content_type.description:
MIME type of the audio at `url`. Literal `audio/webm`
in v1.

dashboard_url.description:
Permanent (auth-gated) link to the Voicegram in the Voicegram
dashboard.

tags.description:
User-supplied tags from the dashboard Tags input. Distinct
from the AI-derived `summary.urgency` / `.sentiment` /
`.intent` fields. Empty array when the user has not tagged
the Voicegram.

google_review.description:
The Google review step for this Voicegram: whether it was on,
the review link, and the text the sender was offered. Always
present. It records the step as it was when the Voicegram was
processed, and webhooks and `GET /api/v1/voicegrams/recent`
report the same saved values, so changing a widget's or
campaign's location later does not change them. Voicegrams
processed before this field was added report `enabled: false`
with both values null, even if the sender was offered a
review. What the sender did next (copied the text, opened
Google) happens after this event and is not included; it shows
in the message's activity in your dashboard.

enabled.description:
`true` when the Google review step was on for the widget
or campaign this Voicegram came from when it was
processed: a Google review location was chosen for it and
your plan included Google reviews. `false` otherwise, and
then `review_url` and `draft_text` are both null.

review_url.description:
The Google review link the sender was offered for that
location. Always set when `enabled` is `true`, null when
it is `false`.

draft_text.description:
The review text the sender was offered: their own message
as transcribed, with card numbers and Social Security
numbers spoken aloud masked, and a very long message
shortened to 4,096 characters. The sender can edit it
before posting, so a posted review may differ. Null when
`enabled` is `false` or when the recording had no detected
speech.

url.description:
HTTPS URL to POST events to. Must be a terminal receiver: `3xx`
responses are treated as delivery failures (`redirect_blocked`).

channel_id.description:
Optional. When null the subscription fires for all channels on
the account. When set, the server derives `channel_type` from
the id; mismatch returns `400 invalid_channel_id`.

source.description:
Whether the subscription was created via Zapier or the dashboard.
Send `zapier` or `dashboard`; this governs whether
`zapier_subscription_id` is required.

WebhookSubscription.description:
Webhook subscription row. NEVER includes the plaintext `secret`.
The plaintext was returned exactly once in the POST 201 response
and is unrecoverable afterwards.

secret_prefix.description: First 12 characters of the signing secret (e.g. `vg_whsec_012`).

channel_id.description: Null when the subscription fires for all channels.

channel_type.description:
Null when `channel_id` is null. Read-only; cannot be changed
after creation.

is_active.description:
False once soft-deleted (via `DELETE /api/v1/webhook-subscriptions/{id}`)
or auto-disabled after 5 consecutive failed events.

consecutive_failures.description:
Number of consecutive events (full retry cycles) that have
failed for this subscription. Resets to 0 on any `2xx` delivery.
Triggers auto-disable at 5.

last_error.description: Most recent error excerpt, to help diagnose delivery failures.

created_by_user_id.description:
Populated for `source=dashboard` rows (the dashboard user who
created the row). Null for `source=zapier` rows.

WebhookSubscriptionWithSecret.description:
Subset of the WebhookSubscription shape returned ONLY by the POST
201 response. Includes the plaintext `secret` which is never
returned by any other endpoint.

secret.description:
Plaintext signing secret. Returned ONCE in this response. After
this response the plaintext is unrecoverable from any API.
Save it in a secure secret store on your end. To rotate,
delete the subscription and create a new one.

secret_prefix.description:
First 12 characters of the signing secret (e.g. `vg_whsec_012`).
Safe to display in lists, logs, and dashboards.

total.description:
Total row count matching the request's filters (account +
`source` + `is_active`), ignoring `limit`/`offset`. Use to
decide whether further pages exist.

Error.description:
Standard error response. The `error` field carries a stable enum
code suitable for client diagnostics. The `message` field is human
readable and may change wording between releases. The optional
`issues` array surfaces schema-validation errors and only appears
on `validation_error` responses.

reason.description:
Stable diagnostic string. Only set on `invalid_url` responses.
Treat this as an open set and match on the prefix before the colon
when one is present. Bare (colon-less) values: `url_parse_failed`,
`scheme_must_be_https`, `url_must_not_contain_credentials`,
`hostname_is_localhost`, `dns_lookup_returned_no_addresses`.
Address/message-suffixed values of the form `<reason>: <detail>`:
`host_resolves_to_private_ip: 10.0.0.5`,
`ipv4_is_private_or_loopback: 127.0.0.1`,
`ipv6_is_private_or_loopback: ::1`, and
`dns_lookup_failed: <message>`.

issues.description:
Schema-validation issues. Only set on `validation_error`
responses. Each entry has a `path` array and a `message`.

Unauthorized.description:
The PAT is missing, malformed, expired, or revoked. The body always
reports `error: "invalid_token"` regardless of the underlying reason.

example.message: Authentication failed. Provide a valid PAT in the Authorization header.

PlanRequired.description:
PAT is valid but the account is on the free plan. All v1 endpoints
except `/me` require a paid plan.

example.message: This action requires a paid Voicegram plan. Upgrade at https://voicegram.io/dashboard/billing/change-plan.

NotFound.description:
Returned whether the subscription does not exist or belongs to a
different account.

RateLimited.description: Per-account rate limit exceeded. Back off and retry.

example.message: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error. Safe to retry.
